The practical takeaway to get your house back in order! Three great mayo swaps for a healthier lunch!

programme.title: How To Fix A Broken Family
programme.desc: You've heard people complain, "If I only knew then what I know now, I wouldn't be in this mess," but what about those times when you choose not to see the writing on the wall? Dr. Phil meets couples who say their relationships went from bad to worse after they said, "I do," and now their families are broken.

programme.title: Heroin Twins
programme.desc: Brandon is a drug addict in recovery who credits Dr. Phil’s intervention with saving his life. Now, he and his mother, Debbie, pay it forward by staging interventions for families and their drug addicted loved ones. Dee saw an episode with Brandon and wrote to Dr. Phil for help with her 23-year-old twin daughters, Brooke and Tiffany, who are addicted to heroin and other prescription drugs. Both women have young children, who are often left to parent each other, as well as take care of their sick mothers. Dee and her husband, Danny, and their two other children, Ashley and Derrick, are united in the goal to save the girls’ lives, but will they be prepared when Dr. Phil makes them all take a hard look at themselves? Find out why Dr. Phil says the whole family is sick. Will the twins agree to treatment? And what will happen to their children? Don’t miss this shocking story!

programme.title: Spoiled Rotten: My Son Needs A Reality Check
programme.desc: Two moms ask Dr. Phil to give their sons a reality check. Rita says her son, Eric, changed his name to “King Keith” and is forgoing a college education to pursue a singing career. Has he lost touch with reality? And, Cheryl says her college-educated son, Patrick, is lazy and lacks ambition.

programme.title: The Truth About Liars
programme.desc: Katie says she's at the end of her rope with her husband, John's, lies and if he doesn't start telling the truth, she'll leave him. She says John has lied about everything from pretending to have a job to having cancer and that they've even lost their house because of the deceit. Katie admits that she knew John was a liar during the 10 years that they dated -- so why did she marry him and have a baby with him? John confesses that he's deceived people for as long as he can remember and claims that he's just looking for attention. When he reveals even more jaw-dropping lies to Katie, will she head for the door? Plus, don't miss Dr. Phil's tips from his new book, Life Code about how to identify the people who will lie, cheat, use and abuse you.

programme.title: Daddy Drama
programme.desc: Dr. Phil delves into the emotional story of a father who has transitioned from a man to a woman, leaving two daughters struggling to understand how someone they loved so much could hurt them so badly.

programme.title: Backstabbing Friends
programme.desc: Losing the friendship of your closest confidant can be as painful and devastating as a divorce. Michele and Christy were best friends for 20 years, but times have changed. Michele says Christy went behind her back and married her fiancé and father of her son! Christy says Michele has now brainwashed her stepson against her. Concerned for the 10-year-old boy caught in the middle, can Dr. Phil broker a peace between the former BFFs? And, Britney and Ashley’s friendship took a bad turn when Britney decided not to name Ashley the godmother of her newborn son. After the snub, Ashley sent Britney hundreds of texts and e-mails to try to work things out, but Britney feels harassed and says she’s not interested in reconciliation. Learn the appropriate boundaries for maintaining healthy friendships and the signs that a friendship has turned toxic.

programme.title: Fight Over Teen's Baby
programme.desc: Statistics show that 2,000 teens get pregnant every day. Moms and dads: Watch this show with your teenagers, because it can impact their lives and yours! Two families face off over who should raise baby Miley. Paige, 17, and her boyfriend, Jordan, 18, are determined to raise their child on their own, even though they live with Jordan’s dad, Chris. Nikki, Paige’s stepmom, thinks she and her husband should raise the child, because they can better provide for her, and she wants Paige to break up with Jordan. Why does she believe that Jordan is brainwashing Paige? The teen dad says Nikki is the one who’s controlling, and he’s stepped up to the plate. Will the families come to an agreement? See what Dr. Phil tells them they must do to ensure Miley grows up in a healthy environment. Plus, find out the 10 things teens want their parents to know about teen sex.

programme.title: Torn Between Two Bridesmaids
programme.desc: If your maid of honor isn't fulfilling her duties, is it OK to find another? Brittany says her best friend of 19 years, Daina, was late for appointments, refused to help with planning and didn't approve of her husband-to-be, so she asked her to step down. Daina says she tried to be there for her friend, but felt like she was getting shut out. What went wrong? In her place, Brittany asked Daina's sister, Noelle, to fill the role. Despite fears that it would cause further strain to her relationship with her sister, Noelle accepted, and now they’re at odds. Are there deeper issues at play? Can Dr. Phil restore these friendships? Then, Amanda says when her mother, Lisa, remarried and failed to ask her to be the maid of honor, she decided to skip the wedding all together. Why didn’t Lisa want her daughter by her side? Both admit their relationship has turned nasty, but is it so bad that Amanda would consider excluding Lisa from her own upcoming wedding? Don’t miss Dr. Phil’s advice for how

programme.title: Parental Alienation: Who’s To Blame?

Mark and his new wife, Mikel, say they’re afraid of Sara but are willing to face her onstage with Dr. Phil. Can these exes put the past behind them and make peace? And, is Sara’s 22-year-old daughter willing to fix their broken relationship?

programme.desc: The Doctors tackle topics from the bedroom to the bathroom that make even the most stalwart blush. Hear S-E-X-planations for how to turn up the heat in the bedroom, and get solutions for ugly feet, spider veins and more!

programme.title: SCOTT PETERSON JURORS
programme.desc: The Christmas Eve 2002 disappearance of Laci Peterson and her unborn son, Conner, caught the attention of the nation and started a massive search for the beautiful pregnant wife. But as the case unfolded, the obsession with this story turned into outrage. Ultimately, 12 jurors not only found Scott Peterson guilty of killing his wife and his unborn child, they unanimously voted that he be put to death by lethal injection. For nearly six months the jurors submersed themselves in a case of cold-blooded murder; and now, in a daytime exclusive, they join Dr. Phil to tell their incredible story.

programme.title: WAS MORGAN MURDERED BY A STALKER?
programme.desc: In December 2011, 20-year-old Morgan was found dead in her bedroom of a suspected drug overdose. Authorities later ruled Morgan’s death a suicide, but her parents, Toni and Steve, say that they believe something far more sinister was at play. They claim that Morgan’s former friend and neighbor, Brooke, 18, and Brooke’s ex-boyfriend stalked and tormented Morgan in her final days and eventually killed her. Toni and Steve say they have home surveillance footage showing shadowy figures on their property on several occasions but does it point the finger at anyone in particular? Plus, Toni says she has enough proof to reopen the investigation into Morgan’s death but does she? Then, Brooke joins the show with her father, Jim, and faces off against her accusers. How does she answer to the allegations against her? Tune in and decide for yourself: Was Morgan murdered?

programme.title: A MOTHER MISSING, A STEPFATHER ACCUSED PT.1
programme.desc: Shelbie’s mother, Carie, disappeared on Dec. 2, 2014, and she says she believes her stepfather, Ed, or Ed’s daughter, Lauren, had something to do with it. Ed claims Carie was a drunk who spiraled out of control, using drugs and attempting suicide in the weeks before her disappearance and left their home voluntarily. Dr. Phil delves into what made a 48-year-old mother walk out of the house without car keys, wallet, phone or coat on a cold December night!

programme.title: MISSING MOM: WHAT HAPPENED TO CARIE?
programme.desc: Ed says his missing wife, Carie, has been seen around town multiple times and says he believes she is alive and will return home soon. Carie’s daughter, Shelbie, says most of Ed’s leads have ended in wild goose chases. She says she is tired of Ed and his daughter, Lauren, lying and wants Ed to admit the truth about her mom’s disappearance.

programme.title: RACHEL LEIGH HUTSON STORY
programme.desc: On Thanksgiving Day 2013, the Hutson family’s celebration turned deadly when 19-year-old Rachel fatally shot her mother while her father was out shopping – and then texted her father a photo of her mother’s body. Rachel's lawyers say she had a history of mental illness that had gone undiagnosed for years. Did the added stress of caring for her ailing mother push her to snap? Or did she have a different motive? In an exclusive interview, will what caused her to commit this unthinkable crime finally be revealed? And, Rachel comes face-to-face with her family for the first time since she was sentenced.

programme.title: Why Men Cheat
programme.desc: Em says her husband, Shawn, has cheated on her with at least 78 women -- so why does she keep taking him back? Shawn admits to at least 20 affairs but says it’s his wife’s fault that he strays.

programme.title: Our Sister Lived In The Bushes And Tried To Hire Someone To Kill Her: What’s Wrong With Her?
programme.desc: Ann Marie and Jackie say their sister, Colleen, is living in a world of make-believe where she constantly plays the victim and lies for money and attention. The siblings say Colleen has disappeared for days at a time and once lived in the woods for two weeks -- and paid a homeless man to try to kill her -- in an attempt to make her family believe she was dead. They also claim Colleen has faked a heart attack, falsely accused a neighbor of rape and most recently told them she’s receiving treatments for cervical cancer -- which they believe is just another lie. Dr. Phil brings the sisters together in search of answers -- and a resolution. How does Colleen explain her erratic behavior? And, is she really suffering from cancer? Plus, Ann Marie and Jackie admit they have enabled Colleen over the years by giving her money and food and paying her bills -- can they learn to put their foot down and help Colleen get her life back on track?

programme.title: “Don’t Give My Daughter Money: She Is Lying About Dying From Cancer”
programme.desc: Mary’s 30-year-old daughter, Lynn, claims to be suffering from numerous medical conditions, including stomach cancer, heart disease, uterine cancer, rheumatoid arthritis and other ailments -- but Mary believes it’s all lies, concocted to gain money and attention. Mary says she has found no evidence of her daughter’s health conditions and was horrified to learn that Lynn had created a crowdfunding website, asking for donations for medical expenses. Lynn insists she’s gravely ill and says it sickens her even more that her mother doesn’t believe her. The mother and daughter face each other for the first time in a year on Dr. Phil’s stage. programme.title: Mail Call D-Day Special
programme.desc: R. Lee Ermey, who played the sergeant in "Full Metal Jacket", applies his gruff sense of humor in this half-hour series that answers viewers' mail about what the armed forces were, and really are, like! Shot on location, Ermey reads the questions on air and then sends them out to military experts in the field for answers and brief demonstrations.

programme.title: How Do You Know If You're in Love
programme.desc: In the Big City, true love is increasingly hard to achieve. But what if brave souls, yearning for romance and a loving partnership, agree to a provocative proposal: getting married at first sight? This groundbreaking format offers a shockingly novel twist on the relationship, dating and wedding space. Four experts - a therapist, anthropologist, spiritualist and clinical psychologist - will create what they believe are three perfect couples. The twist is that these couples will never meet or know each other until they walk down the aisle and see each other face to face - for the first time - at the altar. Each self-contained episode will track classic lifestyle stories of newlyweds: the honeymoon; early nesting; meeting the in-laws; and other universally relatable events of married life. Will they remain together in the end, or decide to separate?

programme.title: Couples' Cam: Something's Brewing
programme.desc: From life's lows like coping with difficult medical diagnoses, to highs like the thrill of moving into a new home or the joys of pregnancy and babies, we watch as the couples experience the many facets of marriage.

programme.title: In A Family Way
programme.desc: In ARRANGED, three couples from different cultural backgrounds have one thing in common-- the belief in arranged marriages. From a Romani gypsy couple in New York City, to a southern couple from the Bible belt, to a couple raised by traditional Eastern Indian parents living in Los Angeles-- these brides and grooms don't just marry each other, their unions include their entire family. Viewers will see each couple's relationship from the lead-up to their weddings to the several months after the reality of married life sinks in.

programme.title: Love and Hate (#101)
programme.desc: Unconventional couples on their way to the altar face staunch criticism from loved ones who refuse to give their blessing and set aside personal prejudices about differences_x000D_ in race, religion, class, or sexuality. With wedding plans well in the works, couples, and their futures are on the line. Which couples love will be enough to outweigh the opposition? Which will crack under the pressure? Whose family and friends will show up? And of those that do, will they voice their disapproval or forever hold their_x000D_ peace?

programme.title: Happily Ever Arranged?
programme.desc: In ARRANGED, three couples from different cultural backgrounds have one thing in common-- the belief in arranged marriages. From a Romani gypsy couple in New York City, to a southern couple from the Bible belt, to a couple raised by traditional Eastern Indian parents living in Los Angeles-- these brides and grooms don't just marry each other, their unions include their entire family. Viewers will see each couple's relationship from the lead-up to their weddings to the several months after the reality of married life sinks in.

programme.title: The Voice In The Lake
programme.desc: However shocking the crime, media headlines eventually fade, but for heartbroken friends and family, the memories and their longing for justice never do. Cold Case Files? produced by the team behind Investigative ReportsTM, digs deep into the past, following detectives as they strive to breathe new life into "cold" unsolved crimes. Armed with the latest DNA technology and with dogged determination, investigators seek new leads in hopes of bringing the guilty to justice decades after the crimes have been committed. Whether it's a man who was initially a prime suspect in his son's death, watching as the police begin to suspect his wife or the gruesome shooting of an elderly couple whose bodies were found in the woods, each episode features a different cold case.

programme.desc: However shocking the crime, media headlines eventually fade, but for heartbroken friends and family, the memories and their longing for justice never do. Cold Case Files? produced by the team behind Investigative ReportsTM, digs deep into the past, following detectives as they strive to breathe new life into "cold" unsolved crimes. Armed with the latest DNA technology and with dogged determination, investigators seek new leads in hopes of bringing the guilty to justice decades after the crimes have been committed. Whether it's a man who was initially a prime suspect in his son's death, watching as the police begin to suspect his wife or the gruesome shooting of an elderly couple whose bodies were found in the woods, each episode features a different cold case.

programme.title: Return of Black Monkey
programme.desc: This story deals with aspects of the European Colonization of the African continent in a very simple but unique way. The story also suggests that, both the Black Man and the White Man worship the same Almighty God but through different mediums.

Zimbabwe became independent in 1980. A fierce liberation war had brought the long-awaited freedom, but the scars of this war are still felt until today. And the spoils of the war were only going to be shared with a few...

programme.title: Live Connections: Runtown
programme.desc: "Get ready for a captivating experience with 'Soundgod' Afrobeats Artist Runtown and his band. In this one-hour special, follow Runtown, his talented dancers, and the dedicated film crew as they prepare for a spectacular live event in London.

programme.title: Anna Ferrah's Story
programme.desc: Anna, married to Tobi, struggles with infertility. After Tobiâ€™s mother moves in, tensions rise, culminating in a fight where Anna learns sheâ€™s blamed for the coupleâ€™s childlessness. The mother storms out, is â€œkidnapped,â€ and demands ransom, warning against police involvement. Anna alerts Inspector Mike anyway. Tobi pays the ransom, but Mike traces the money, uncovering a shocking truth: Tobiâ€™s mother faked her kidnapping to frame Anna and push Tobi into remarrying her best friend. Exposed, sheâ€™s arrested and confesses. But Tobi still blames Anna and leaves her.

programme.title: Once Upon a Family
programme.desc: Every family has its issues, and this one is no exception. Once Upon A Family tells the story of a complicated Ghanaian family and the dark secrets they wished to hide - but all comes to light during the family reunion of a lifetime.

programme.title: Kienyeji
programme.desc: Kienyeji tells the story of two university students, Cynthia and Charlie, from conflicting Kenyan communities who fall in love and plan to marry despite their families' opposition. The narrative explores tribalism and cultural differences as their attempts to unite face challenges, including a failed ruracio due to unpaid dowry, food poisoning at a second attempt, and ultimately, divorce pressured by Charlie's father. Amid exams, financial struggles, and personal setbacks, their journey unfolds with Ohangla and Mugithi music, raising questions about love and tradition. Will love triumph, or will societal pressures prevail?

programme.title: Mono
programme.desc: "Young students arrive at the prestigious Francis Morris Morton Mission High School (Framomo) to join Form One. Their parents believe that this is the right school to turn their sons into men. As the boys discover a deep and sinister rot in the school, they try to fight for their voice, but it could cost them more than they are willing to sacrifice. Will Oliver and his friends survive Framomo?"

programme.title: Prato Frio
programme.desc: Erica, a 19-year-old young woman, lives a seemingly perfect life with her wealthy parents. But her world shatters when armed intruders break into their home and brutally murder her family. As she grieves, the truth comes to light â€” "Frozen Revenge" unfolds as a gripping psychological thriller exploring trauma, betrayal, and vengeance, set against the backdrop of modern-day Mozambique. A powerful story of a young woman who turns pain into a relentless pursuit of revenge.

programme.title: Villains in the Metropolis
programme.desc: A brilliant young medical doctor, stunningly beautiful, morphs into a heartless murderer after a positive pregnancy test, and a cheating lover.

programme.title: The Department
programme.desc: She used to live in Lagos, Nigeria and run industrial sabotage for a Nigerian conglomerate until she got married and moved to the suburbs. Now she's a bored housewife and her company wants her back for one last job. She accepts against the wishes of her husband who then decides to sabotage the project in an attempt to save their marriage.

programme.title: Strawberry Chinny
programme.desc: After a brutal breakup leaves her homeless, a 28-year-old makeup artist moves in with her childhood best friend, but their platonic bond is tested when his demanding new girlfriend enters the picture, forcing them to confront their true feelings for each other.

programme.title: The Confessor
programme.desc: Rev. Johnson a thirty-five year old priest loses his sister and only remaining family member at the hands of some armed robbers. His efforts to get the police to bring the culprits to book prove abortive, as they made no serious efforts to hunt down the criminals. Disappointed in the way the Nigerian police handled the case, he went away for a while to try to heal and returns a year later to continue his role as a priest. 3 years later, he listens to the confession of an armed robber who narrates a brutal rape and murder of a girl, five years earlier. This brought back old memories and a battle with his conscience, faith and deep seated hate still lies in his heart. After listening to the confession of the armed robber, it becomes clear that he was one of the robber's responsible for his sister's death. He decides to take the law into his own hands by finding all the men responsible for his sister's death and make them pay for their actions. This new development sends chills down the spine of members of the community, as the police and the people begin to wonder if they now have a vigilant or just a murderer.

programme.title: Soul Boy
programme.desc: Nairobi, Kenya. 14 year-old Abila lives with his parents in Kibera, one of the largest slums in East Africa. One morning the teenager discovers his father ill and delirious. Someone has stolen his soul, mumbles the father as he sits huddled in a corner. Abila is shocked and confused but wants to help his father and goes in search of a suitable cure. Supported by his friend Shiku who is the same age as him, he learns that his father has gambled his soul away in the company of a spiritual woman. The teenager doesn’t want to believe it and sets about looking for the witch. When he finally discovers her in the darkest corner of the ghetto, she gives him seven challenging tasks to save his father’s lost soul. Abila embarks on an adventurous journey which leads him right through the microcosm of his home town.

programme.title: Wheel and Deal
programme.desc: Addicted to the desire for this pleasurable life leads a retired Marine Corps to plot a scheme along with a computer genius on how to get rich regardless of those involved. A one million dollars life insurance policy is his initiative and his children;Georgia, Kelvin and Regina are his beneficiaries including his grandchildren (Ben Jr & Benita). To receive the money once he’s dead, he carries on his first plan. He and his felon partner who happens to be a genius in hijacking, infiltrate the health system, pose as the personal to Kels by creating a terminal disease that Kels (this Ex-Marie Corps) suffers from.

programme.desc: No one can kill your dreams.

programme.desc: Men and women have different perceptions about the world. They react differently to societal actions. How do they manage to overcome their contradictions in order to live a harmonious couple life.

programme.title: Gacal
programme.desc: Lonely and heartbroken, Assad is left at home while his charming brother, Nuur, heads out on a long-awaited date with a woman he has been pursuing. Little does Assad know that this day will turn his life upside down. Just as Nuur steps out, a sudden knock on the door startles Assad. Opening it, he is met with a powerful punch to the face. Standing before him is Barkhad, the husband of the woman Nuur is currently on a date with. Barkhad, in a case of mistaken identity, believes Assad is his wife's illicit lover.Fueled by anger and a desire to seek revenge on Nuur, Barkhad decides to take matters into his own hands. He restrains Assad as he waits, knife in hand, for Nuur to return. As the day unfolds, a twist of fate intertwines the lives of Assad, Barkhad, and Nuur. Forced to spend time together, Assad and Barkhad gradually find common ground and an unexpected bond. Sharing their stories and vulnerabilities, they start to question their judgments and perceptions of one another.

programme.title: Daughters of Donald
programme.desc: Chief Donald is living the later years of his life in lonesome luxury and perfect celibacy. But the peace and quiet in his big mansion are shattered when one young lady, and then another, suddenly show up claiming to be his daughters from past relationships he had completely forgotten about. And it will not stop there: everyone is now a suspect as ghosts from Chief Donald’s adventurous past come to haunt him in the form of children, he never knew he had, including some who have been living and working right under his nose, unbeknownst to him. The cultural conflicts and heartbreaking drama resulting from this late discovery of self, and the trauma imposed by DNA tests and struggles for belonging, are only subdued by the hilarious natures of the comic characters who bring the whole story to life. The movie is set in Asaba (Nollywood), Nigeria, featuring actors from Cameroon and Nigeria. Generous use of African Music provided by BGC Melody from Cameroon, Congo DRC, Ghana and Nigeria. Executive Production by Don Julio Bats for BGC Melody Story

programme.title: In My Father's Village
programme.desc: Rhuveneko, 19, rides on a bus and opens a picture book, gazing at old pictures of her father. She goes back to his village to claim her inheritance, but things have changed. Zimbabwe became independent in 1980. A fierce liberation war had brought the long-awaited freedom, but the scars of this war are still felt until today. And the spoils of the war were only going to be shared with a few...

programme.title: Moms at War
programme.desc: Moms at War is about two mothers who live in the same neighborhood, but hate each other. One felt that the other was a village girl who just got into money and is not fit to be in society with them. But both their kids coincidentally attend the same school and there was a competition that was done for the kids, and both were the top of their class. It comes down to one of them winning the competition and the mothers just go crazy, doing all sort of antics. It's a story of friendship, sisterhood, and bonding in spite of everything.

programme.title: Minga et la Cuissinière
programme.desc: Minga is an orphaned girl living with her stepmother Mami Kaba and her stepsister Abena. One day, when she was washing dishes in the river, she accidentally broke a spoon. A furious Mami Kaba then chased her away from the house, asking her to find the only identical spoon hidden by her late mother. A adventurous journey then begins for Minga in the forest.

programme.title: Kileo
programme.desc: Tabu (30s) is a high-performing secondary school English teacher, struggling with alcoholism. Intelligent but reckless, Tabu is cheerful most especially when under the influence, and is a low-spirited nerd when level headed.

programme.title: Watatu
programme.desc: Yusuf is a young university graduate suffering discrimination, lack of opportunity and is raging against injustice. He slowly becomes seduced by extremist thought, which leaves his family powerless to dissuade him. His Uncle Salim, the only father figure in his life, is helpless in the face of his nephew’s ideology. When Salim discovers his new next-door neighbour is actually his long lost childhood friend, Jack, he is delighted. But Jack has become a policeman, a job which in a City increasingly divided by religion and tribe and simmering with violence, places a seemingly unbridgeable gulf between them. Yusuf, Jack and Salim’s lives become fatally and irrevocably entwined as Salim struggles to hold his friendship, family and community together. But Yusuf’s sister has another plan. Knowing that the communities of Mombasa may have the solution, she takes her story to the streets. As the film morphs into a documentary, we see real people in Mombasa assume the roles of Yusuf’s mother, sister and uncle, taking the story into their own hands to determine a new ending and in doing so give voice to the majority Muslim community of coastal Kenya drowned out by extremists on the one side and Government repression on the other. Can the citizens of Mombasa change the tragic outcome of this story?

programme.title: Zahma
programme.desc: Zahma (2023) It tells a story of a widow, Munira raises her despondent teenage son Zuber alone after her husband Changawa disappears mysteriously. When she discovers that a village boy is behind her son's misery, she seeks the help of a former witchcraft practitioner named Zobe. However, chaos ensues when dark secrets reveal Zobe's involvement in Changawa's disappearance.

programme.title: Rishai
programme.desc: Nyakio finds herself consumed by depression and overwhelming guilt following the tragic drowning of her son. Her despair reaches a breaking point, leading her to contemplate taking her own life. With a noose around her neck as she is about to surrender to the darkness, Jay, a tough debt collector working for a local loan shark, storms into her home. Nyakio owes money and he’s come to collect. Fate brings these two disparate souls together, forcing them to share an unexpected weekend. As they reluctantly share this time, Nyakio gradually realizes that Jay carries his own profound emotional wounds, which bear a surprising resemblance to her own. Through their shared experiences and unforeseen misadventures, Nyakio and Jay unwittingly heal each other along the way and get within the grasp of finding hope and a will to live.

programme.title: The Pretty Ones Are The Loneliest
programme.desc: Emem is a 37-year old woman in a rocky marriage not helped by the fact that her teenage son from a previous relationship, Bassey, always gets in trouble, drawing the angst of his stepfather Tamuno. Emem decides to take him to stay with her Widower Father; Dr. Udoh who had retired and has been living in his country home since the death pf his wife. Bassey who has always searched for a place to belong finds it in his Grandfather's home. They form a bond which transcends that of relatives and he has to help his Grandfather who has a love trouble of his own; He is smitten by a nurse he meets on one of his walks but he has never been with another woman aside his late wife who he had been married to for over 53 years. Emem is still dealing with her crumbling marriage and is tempted when a wild painter she interviews for her magazine falls in love with her. Bassey also somehow gets entangled with an emotionally unavailable girl and all three are trying to overcome their loneliness.

programme.title: Coerced Revenge
programme.desc: A story about a young girl forced to bomb a university by her uncle to save her mother's life.

programme.title: Okomfo Anokye Poma (The Missing Staff)
programme.desc: A man dies and willed all his properties to his son but he can't inherit them unless he goes back to his father's hometown to fight and bring back the Staff of Okomfo Anokye. Okomfo Anokye is a legendary African priest who lived in Ancient times. What is the connection between the Man and OKOMFO ANOKYE and what is the connection between The Past and The Present?

programme.title: Wrong Journey
programme.desc: Some university students go for a trip to a waterfall in a sacred forest for sightseeing and Michael one of them dies. forced to run, they abandon his Corps. as they get to their homes, something is hunting and eliminating them one after the other. until then, Aaron waits and Michael his brother never returned and he has no idea what happened to his twin brother. He decides to go look for him the following day, getting to the waterfall, there lies his brother. Furious and in agony, he screams over his Corps and leaves it the way he met it. immediately as he leaves, a black faceless hooded figure rises from the shrine sterring at him.

programme.title: Red Headed Stranger
programme.desc: Based on a Willie Nelson song, a spirited preacher and his wife come from the East to Montana to serve a country church. However, when overwhelming problems develop, the preacher must take revenge and attempt to save a town from a gang of cruel men.

programme.title: One-Eyed Jacks
programme.desc: After robbing a Mexican bank, two men have their getaway plan go wrong. When one bandit takes their one remaining horse and rides off with the gold, the other is captured. Years later, the two men face off in a deadly game of deceit and revenge.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S02 E06
programme.desc: Cheyenne teams up with Joe Baker to travel south of the border to wrangle wild mustangs. When Joe falls ill, a financial backer and his wife step in to join Cheyenne on the dangerous venture, fighting off renegade Indians along the way.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S02 E07
programme.desc: Amarillo Ames asks Cheyenne to help drive a herd of cattle to Dodge City and take over the mission if he perishes. When Ames dies, Cheyenne must forcefully take on the Laverson brothers, who do not want him in charge of the drive.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S04 E05
programme.desc: Mark takes a job on new neighbor Will Temple's ranch but is taken back by Temple's badly scarred face. When a cavalry officer stops by the McCain Ranch looking for a deserter who committed murder, both Mark and Lucas question who Temple really is.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S04 E06
programme.desc: While repairing a fence on his property, Lucas witnesses a murder. The killer, Corey Hazlett, is the son of a wealthy rancher named Frank Hazlett. When Lucas agrees to testify at Corey's trial, there are threats to harm Mark.

programme.title: Jane Got a Gun
programme.desc: When a frontier woman's husband is severely wounded from gunshots, she learns a vicious gang is hot on his trail and headed to their ranch. With her estranged past fiancé by her side, the two prepare for a violent showdown that consumes them.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S01 E14
programme.desc: A wealthy rancher hires Cheyenne as a ranch foreman. Shortly after he begins his duties, his friend falls in love with the boss' beautiful daughter. However, the rancher has other plans, as his sights are set on Cheyenne to become his new son-in-law.

programme.title: Maverick - S01 E24
programme.desc: Bart Maverick and Big Mike McComb head to a remote Mexican fishing village to help find buried Spanish treasure. But the man who invited them is nowhere to be seen. They find themselves in a dangerous situation with several people, including bandits.

programme.title: Far Haven
programme.desc: In 1887, Hunter Braddock moves back to Far Haven, Arizona to start over with his two young children, but when his father-in-law is brutally attacked he must take on the corrupt forces strangling the town in order to protect what he loves most.

programme.title: Qué Bonito Amor Capítulo 139
programme.desc: Vittoriano libera a Giuliano, pero al intentar matarlo es él quien muere. Susanito se entera que él no puede tener hijos. Rodrigo se pone celoso del nuevo compañero de secundaria de Paloma. Santos decide ayudar a Nano a recordar su pasado.

programme.title: Qué Bonito Amor Capítulo 140
programme.desc: Santos comienza a planear su fuga de la cárcel. Elvira se entera que van a operar a Concho del corazón. Susanito, al sentir que no sirve como hombre, termina con Irasema. Giuliano amenaza a Santos con hacerle daño a sus seres queridos.

programme.title: Qué Bonito Amor Capítulo 141
programme.desc: Giuliano le pide a Justo que le dé 10 millones de dólares a cambio de no hacerle daño a Wendy. Elvira le pide a María que ayude a que su padre acepte que tiene una enfermedad.

programme.title: Qué Bonito Amor Capítulo 142
programme.desc: Santos comienza a alucinar debido a su encierro en la cárcel. Curtis y Derecho unen sus vidas en sagrado matrimonio. María no quita el dedo del renglón y vive con la esperanza de poder volver a Santos.

programme.title: Qué Bonito Amor Capítulo 143
programme.desc: María convence a Susanito de no dejar de luchar por el amor de Irasema. Concho teme morir en el quirófano y no poder volver a ver su familia.

programme.title: Esmeralda Capítulo 27
programme.desc: Tras la visita de Esmeralda a la casa grande, José Armando le propone matrimonio y ella acepta. Lucio Malaver advierte a Esmeralda que no es una buena idea su matrimonio. Rodolfo enfurece al saber los planes de boda de su hijo.

programme.title: Esmeralda Capítulo 28
programme.desc: Blanca le ruega a Esmeralda que se aleje de José Armando, debido a los conflictos con Rodolfo. Crisanta acude a la iglesia por su cargo de conciencia. Adrián se decepciona de Graciela. José Armando decide acelerar su boda.

programme.title: Esmeralda Capítulo 29
programme.desc: Lucio Malaver se hunde en la tristeza y en la depresión al enterarse de la boda de Esmeralda. José Armando pretende llevar a Esmeralda a vivir a la casa grande, Blanca es la única que no tiene problema. Melesio se siente desplazado.

programme.title: Esmeralda Capítulo 30
programme.desc: Fátima aparenta amabilidad con Esmeralda para después hacerla sentir culpable por un florero roto. El Dr. Álvaro manda una carta para prestar sus servicios para la operación de Esmeralda, pero Fátima la roba y la esconde.

programme.title: Esmeralda Capítulo 31
programme.desc: Fermín, para calmar a Lucio Malaver, le cuenta el verdadero origen de Esmeralda. Fátima trata de burlarse de Esmeralda al regalarle unos vestidos, pero José Armando muestra desaprobación. Dominga le cuenta a Esmeralda la verdad sobre sus padres.

programme.title: Pasión y poder Capítulo 27
programme.desc: Al enterarse del terrible secreto de Consuelo y, a pesar de estar esperando un hijo suyo, Erick le pide el divorcio. Para olvidarse de todo, Erick regresa a los brazos de Montserrat, su amante.

programme.title: Pasión y poder Capítulo 28
programme.desc: Eladio lleva al papá de Julia a vivir con ellos. El miedo se apodera de ella y la obliga a terminar con el plan de la prueba de ADN que le pidió en secreto a Arturo. ¿Quién será el verdadero padre de David?

programme.title: Pasión y poder Capítulo 29
programme.desc: Después de discutir con su esposo, Julia cae por las escaleras y sufre un terrible golpe en la cabeza que la deja en coma. ¿Sobrevivirá a este accidente? Arturo se entera del incidente y culpa a Eladio de lo que está sucediendo.

programme.title: Pasión y poder Capítulo 30
programme.desc: Consuelo indaga en el orfanato para descubrir quién le contó a su esposo que vivió en un burdel. Eladio le confiesa a David que la verdadera razón de su rivalidad con Arturo es la relación que tuvo con su madre y aún no lo olvida.

programme.title: Pasión y poder Capítulo 31
programme.desc: Nina le reclama a Arturo por la relación que tuvo con Julia, pero él niega todo y le advierte que sus celos acabarán con su matrimonio. Después del accidente de Julia, ella le advierte a Eladio que el amor que quedaba entre ellos se terminó.

programme.title: Amores con Trampa Capítulo 47
programme.desc: Esteban va a buscar a Estefany a su casa, se encuentra con Santiago y pelean. Santiago encuentra a Isabel en el departamento de Esteban. Felipe le pregunta a Isabel si Alejandra es hija de Esteban.

programme.title: Amores con Trampa Capítulo 48
programme.desc: Santiago le asegura a Isabel que le hará una prueba de ADN a Alejandra para comprobar si son padre e hija. Hilda arranca un pelo de Rocío y amenaza con hacer brujería para que no sea feliz con Alberto. Facundo anuncia su reconciliación con María.

programme.title: Amores con Trampa Capítulo 49
programme.desc: Santiago se entera que Alejandra sí es su hija biológica y estalla de felicidad. Conchita anuncia que se va a trabajar a casa de la familia Carmona. Isabel le dice a María que Facundo ya no siente nada por ella.

programme.title: Amores con Trampa Capítulo 50
programme.desc: Alberto le confiesa a Rocío que la abuela de Hilda es una bruja mala. Esteban amenaza a Isabel con decirle la verdad a Santiago, ahí Alberto los ve juntos. Isabel intenta detener a Esteban mientras conduce a alta velocidad, él se estrella y queda en coma.

programme.title: Amores con Trampa Capítulo 51
programme.desc: Esteban queda en coma después del accidente automovilístico. Estefany logra que Esteban despierte, él le pide que se vaya. Alberto le revela a Isabel que él sabe que ella es la culpable del accidente de Esteban.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - 36 Horas
programme.desc: Una familia con una vida normal cambia de la noche a la mañana cuando el pequeño Oliver es diagnosticado con una agresiva enfermedad. Los padres de Oliver son notificados y comienza el calvario de 36 horas.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Habla El Papa
programme.desc: En una entrevista el Papa Francisco da un regalo a los mexicanos con una charla amena donde fija la postura de la iglesia católica ante diferentes temas como la migración.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Curvas y armas 'Las Buchonas'
programme.desc: Una vida llena de cirugías plásticas, lujos, excesos y armas; mujeres jóvenes y ambiciosas que están dispuestas a todo por tener una buena vida.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Fuga de El Chapo
programme.desc: El líder del cártel de Sinaloa se fuga por segunda vez de una prisión federal en México. Sigue la búsqueda de Joaquín Guzmán Loera, en esta historia se tiene acceso total al lugar de donde se fugó ‘El Chapo’ después de un año y cuatro meses.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Misterio al final del túnel
programme.desc: El escándalo de la fuga de Joaquín Guzmán quien escapó de una celda de 3 x 2 metros y que logró burlar los sistemas de seguridad de la prisión del Altiplano.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Famosos de niños
programme.desc: Madres que vieron a sus hijos triunfar en el mundo del espectáculo cuentan sus historias, el éxito en la niñez donde se vuelven estrellas es un mundo en el que las madres ven a sus hijos como sus pequeños.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Reencuentros
programme.desc: Hay veces que las familias son separadas por situaciones fortuitas. Alejandro Muñoz es un periodista cuyo propósito en su programa de televisión es reunir a familias separadas por diversos motivos. Él nos cuenta algunas de sus experiencias.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Recaptura de El Chapo
programme.desc: Teresa Rodríguez relata la historia de la recaptura de Joaquín Guzmán Loera 'El Chapo'. Desde el escape de 'El Chapo' junto con 'El Cholo' de la casa en Culiacán hasta la captura de ambos delincuentes en un hotel de paso.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Deportation INC
programme.desc: La inmigración a Estados Unidos se ha convertido en una industria con un enfoque monetario. En este episodio se dan a conocer las implicaciones monetarias además de los estragos emocionales que deja en los inmigrantes.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Cruzando al borde
programme.desc: La patrulla fronteriza de Estados Unidos tiene registro de que la mayoría de indocumentados que cruzan la frontera son centroamericanos. Dentro de esta población hay muchos menores de edad que viajan solos para reunirse con sus familiares.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Historias de Puebla York
programme.desc: En Nueva York existe una importante cantidad de población inmigrante proveniente de Casa Blanca, un pueblo del estado de Puebla en México. Ellos desean reunirse de nuevo con sus padres después de muchos años de no verlos.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Juan Gabriel íntimo
programme.desc: Hablan quienes lo conocieron desde niño y quienes fueron testigos de su genio musical. Los rituales antes de enfrentar a su público y el testimonio de quienes permanecieron cerca de él, a un año de su muerte.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Frutos del odio
programme.desc: Intimidación e insultos racistas, amenazas y ataques físicos. Letreros racistas pintados en las paredes, pareciera no haber lugar seguro. Una nueva realidad se está viviendo en muchos vecindarios.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Los mirreyes
programme.desc: Los mirreyes son la nueva generación de los hijos de papi. Privilegiados y desafiantes, tratan con desprecio a quienes les sirven. Los secretos de los hijos de los ricos y los poderosos son la evidencia de la guerra de clases en el México de hoy.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Los Deportables
programme.desc: Las redadas que realizan los agentes de migración han hecho que el miedo tome muchos vecindarios de Estados Unidos. Las historias de quienes han sido deportados son contadas. También las historias de quienes viven temerosos de ser deportados.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Tortura en México
programme.desc: Fueron interrogados, y pronto, las preguntas se convirtieron en golpes. El drama de quienes han sufrido la tortura en carne propia, y también, un ex militar justifica sus acciones.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Alas del narco
programme.desc: El drama de las misteriosas desapariciones de pilotos y los riesgos a los que se exponen en las selvas andinas.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Deportaciones masivas: Miedo y realidad
programme.desc: El miedo a las deportaciones masivas, dentro de las comunidades latinas, aumentó después de nuevas reglas anunciadas para la expulsión de inmigrantes indocumentados. Los inmigrantes están cansados de vivir en la ansiedad y han decidido auto deportarse.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Inmigración: Las nuevas reglas
programme.desc: Las recientes redadas de inmigración en varios estados de la nación han despertado el temor en muchas comunidades. Familias trabajadoras están pensando dos veces antes de salir a su empleo o enviar los niños a la escuela.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Traicionados por la justicia
programme.desc: Alrededor de cincuenta jóvenes de un mismo vecindario recibieron acusaciones de homicidios que los marcaron para siempre. Algunos pasaron décadas en prisión, otros están aún intentando limpiar sus nombres.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - En la boca del lobo
programme.desc: En medio de las tensiones raciales de los últimos meses, Ilia Calderón se adentra en el mundo del grupo supremacista blanco Ku Klux Klan y entrevista a uno de sus líderes. El encuentro está lleno de amenazas e insultos.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - La amenaza de la amapola
programme.desc: En los campos de la Sierra de Guerrero, México, florecen la amapola y la violencia. Familias campesinas se ganan la vida con los cultivos ilegales, mientras que los carteles de la droga buscan controlar el mercado.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Ángeles y Demonios
programme.desc: Salmo 100 es una organización que lleva mensajes de paz y reconciliación. Las historias de Daniel, Adrián o Giovanni son ejemplos que usa Salmo 100 para ayudar a más personas que quieren salir del mundo del crimen organizado en la frontera.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Doble vida
programme.desc: De día es un estudiante universitario, de noche bailarín exótico. Para unos era su guía espiritual, para otros era un peligro para su comunidad.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Burlando la muerte
programme.desc: Personas que por diferentes razones del destino han estado al borde de la muerte, pero han recibido una segunda oportunidad para continuar con sus vidas. Desde accidentes con puentes desplomados, ataques por celos, sobrevivientes de terremotos y más.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Magnates de Dios
programme.desc: Se han convertido en emporios religiosos multinacionales donde van de la mano el dinero y la fe, un negocio multimillonario, pastores y predicadores evangélicos que llevan vidas opulentas. Tienen problemas con la autoridad por diversas denuncias.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Muerte río arriba
programme.desc: La vida tranquila de un pueblo fue afectada por ataques inesperados. Una lancha con 16 pasajeros sufrió el peor destino que pudieran imaginar. Wilmer cuenta la pesadilla que vivió cuando agentes de la DEA confunden la embarcación en la que iba.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Caminando al borde
programme.desc: Miles de migrantes que han sido recibidos entre hostilidad y protestas en la frontera sur deberán enfrentar una nueva realidad, pero la esperanza los acompaña. El camino para llegar a Estados Unidos es muy peligroso.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Chicos malos
programme.desc: Una nueva generación de artistas del género urbano domina las listas de éxito a nivel mundial. Las letras de sus canciones están plagadas de violencia, crimen, sexo y drogas que se han convertido en una multimillonaria industria.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Atorados
programme.desc: Atrapados entre el pasado y un futuro que simplemente no puede llegar, un muro se interpone entre la realidad y sus sueños. Miles de migrantes centroamericanos, quedan atorados en su recorrido por México para alcanzar el sueño americano.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - ¿Comida cruel?
programme.desc: Una pareja acepta el reto de cambiar sus hábitos alimenticios, dejar de comer carne y llevar una dieta balanceada. Y la historia de Yumalay Díaz, un niño de 4 años que, con su participación en un reality, quiere cambiar su vida y la de sus papás.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Amores que matan
programme.desc: Una mujer contrata a unos sicarios para asesinar a su marido, pero él descubre la verdad y logra salvar su vida. Miguel Ignacio Mendoza el grupo de música urbana “Chino y Nacho”, cuenta un poco de su historia de vida.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Un crimen casi perfecto
programme.desc: Una hermosa mujer y de buen corazón, es asesinada por su esposo, un hombre manipulador y frío que dejó abandonada a su propia hija en los brazos de su madre fallecida.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Secretos de las mucamas de Trump
programme.desc: Declaraciones de mujeres que trabajaron para la familia Trump y secretos que salen a la luz después de las fuertes palabras del presidente contra miles de personas.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Buscando en el desierto
programme.desc: Familias que pierden a sus seres queridos en la inmensidad del desierto sin poder hacer nada para saber de ellos, pero la esperanza no muere y arriesgarán todo para recuperarlos. Migrantes que intentan cruzar la frontera hacia los Estados Unidos, mueren.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - La viuda negra
programme.desc: Una terrible confusión pone en riesgo la libertad de un hombre tras el terrible asesinato de un importante empresario canadiense, pero el destino tiene sorpresas para todos.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Supremacistas: Las redes del odio
programme.desc: El cambio de vida de los inmigrantes que residen en El Paso, Texas. Sus miedos luego de las masacres del 3 de agosto de 2019, cuando un pistolero mató a 22 personas y les declaró la guerra a los hispanos.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Desafiar el olvido
programme.desc: Algunos fueron perseguidos y separados de sus familias, otros llevados a campos de concentración y exterminados, hoy, algunos de los sobrevivientes narran el horror del holocausto judío.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Asesinadas
programme.desc: La historia de cinco mujeres que han sufrido de la violencia física. Un desenlace común tras una vida llena de tortura, la muerte es inevitable. Los feminicidios es alarmante, el porcentaje aumenta.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - La vida en juego: fútbol y violencia en la frontera
programme.desc: Un programa especial que muestra la vida de cuatro jugadores de fútbol americano en Brownsville, Texas; quienes se enfrentan a una dura realidad de violencia, pobreza y drogas, pero siempre con ilusión de una vida mejor.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Narcosubmarinos: Viaje al fondo del mal
programme.desc: Por décadas, el narcotráfico ha navegado sigilosamente por los mares más peligrosos durante años, para poder transportar su mercancía, poniendo en peligro la vida de sus tripulantes a cambio de dinero.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Ganarle a la muerte
programme.desc: La desgracia de un hombre que, con fuerza y voluntad, cambió su vida tratando de ayudar a sus seres amados. Cuando apenas emprendía el viaje para vivir el sueño americano, la tragedia se cruza en su camino.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Amores migrantes
programme.desc: Ni el tiempo, ni el espacio, ni las fronteras son obstáculos para estar con la persona amada, hombres y mujeres que han hecho grandes sacrificios para estar unidos. Incluso arriesgan su libertad por estar junto a sus seres queridos.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Inundados en plástico
programme.desc: Poco a poco el ser humano termina con el planeta que habita, hoy, el plástico es uno de los mayores enemigos, no se degrada, no desaparece y ahora llena los mares, amenazando su flora y fauna sin control.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Acoso sin cuartel
programme.desc: La muerte de la soldado Vanessa Guillén ha provocado un movimiento nacional para hablar sobre un tema incómodo, la violencia sexual contra las mujeres en las fuerzas armadas, por años los abusos contra ellas han sido una epidemia sin control.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - El menos pensado
programme.desc: Juan Morales cansado de estar confinado en una silla de ruedas decidió desafiar su límites y se convirtió en el distribuidor de drogas de su escuela. Envuelto en violencia callejera, Juan logró salir adelante para volverse un psicólogo.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - El gran golpe
programme.desc: Una banda de asaltantes con armas de juguete se llevó casi veinte millones de dólares de las cajillas de seguridad de un banco, lo sorpendente es que no hubo heridos ni disparos.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Crímenes sin resolver
programme.desc: El tiempo parece moverse en cámara lenta para familiares, amigos y conocidos de personas que han sido víctimas de diferentes crímenes que, desgraciadamente, muchas veces no logran ser resueltos.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - El experimento
programme.desc: El bebé de Maritza Ramírez es secuestrado el día programado para nacer. En su fiesta de 16 años, los síntomas de la enfermedad de Helen reaparecen. Lumpkin, un pueblo olvidado es la ubicación de una cárcel de inmigrantes.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Radiografía de una masacre
programme.desc: Una familia destruida tras un inesperado ataque con armas de fuego, habla sobre todo el sufrimiento que tuvieron que pasar al perder a sus seres queridos en manos de organizaciones delictivas. Una de las masacres más sangrientas y terribles de México.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Fentanilo la nueva apuesta del narco
programme.desc: México es país productor y de tránsito de Fentanilo, un opioide sintético el cual es cada vez más consumido en Estados Unidos. Esta droga causa muchas muertes entre jóvenes. Un kilo de fentanilo genera las mismas ganancias que una tonelada de cocaína.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Desaparecidos de la frontera
programme.desc: Ante la incompetencia de las autoridades, familiares se han convertido en investigadores privados aficionados dispuestos a enfrentar riesgos, ellos dicen vivir una carrera contra el tiempo para evitar que sus seres queridos desaparezcan para siempre.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - El hijo de El Chapo captura y liberación de un intocable
programme.desc: El ejército mexicano despliega un operativo en Culiacán, Sinaloa para detener a un familiar de Joaquín Guzmán Loera 'El Chapo'. El objetivo es capturado, durante un día Culiacán queda atrapado en un enfrentamiento entre el ejército y los narcos.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Emprendiendo sueños
programme.desc: Dos hermanas convirtieron una deliciosa receta de su madre en un gran negocio. Un hombre pasó de ser astronauta a cultivar las mejores uvas para hacer vino.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - La oscura luz del mundo
programme.desc: Tras múltiples denuncias una red de oscuros secretos y abusos a menores es descubierta, los líderes de una iglesia se ven envueltos en terribles crímenes que tendrán que pagar en prisión.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Exonerados: años perdidos
programme.desc: El tráfico ilegal de personas entre República Dominicana y Puerto Rico ha aumentado en los últimos meses, las autoridades hacen todo lo que pueden para mejorar la situación.

programme.title: 20th Century Women
programme.desc: In 1979 Santa Barbara, Calif., Dorothea Fields is a determined single mother in her mid-50s who is raising her adolescent son, Jamie, at a moment brimming with cultural change and rebellion. Dorothea enlists the help of two younger women -- Abbie, a free-spirited punk artist living as a boarder in the Fields' home and Julie, a savvy and provocative teenage neighbor -- to help with Jamie's upbringing.

programme.title: When You Finish Saving the World
programme.desc: Evelyn (Julianne Moore) tries to parent an unassuming teenager at her shelter while her oblivious son Ziggy (Finn Wolfhard) fumbles through his pursuit of a brilliant young woman at school.

programme.title: Dream Scenario
programme.desc: Hapless family man Paul Matthews (Nicolas Cage) finds his life turned upside down when millions of strangers suddenly start seeing him in their dreams. But when his nighttime appearances take a nightmarish turn, Paul is forced to navigate the consequences of his newfound stardom.

programme.title: While We're Young
programme.desc: Middle-aged filmmaker Josh Srebnick (Ben Stiller) and his wife, Cornelia (Naomi Watts), are happily married, but stuck in a rut. So, when free-spirited couple Jamie (Adam Driver) and Darby (Amanda Seyfried) enter their lives, it's like a breath of fresh air -- especially for Josh, who pines for a youth he wishes he had. Soon, Josh and Cornelia are ditching friends their own age to hang out with the hipsters -- but whether the friendship can endure despite a 20-year age gap remains to be seen.

programme.title: The Skeleton Twins
programme.desc: Following many years of estrangement, twins Milo (Bill Hader) and Maggie (Kristen Wiig) have an unexpected reunion after a set of near-tragedies. The situation forces them to confront how their lives became so broken. For Maggie, it means examining why she's so unhappy in a marriage to a loving husband. For Milo, it means meeting with his first love to see if their romance can reignite. Eventually, they learn that living truthfully and accepting each other is the only way to move forward.

programme.title: C'mon C'mon
programme.desc: Johnny and his young nephew forge a tenuous but transformational relationship when they are unexpectedly thrown together in this delicate and deeply moving story about the connections between adults and children, the past and the future.

programme.title: Employee of the Month
programme.desc: Zack (Dane Cook) and Vince (Dax Shepard) are rival co-workers at Super Club, the country's largest bulk-discount retailer, but while Vince is on the fast track at Super Club, Zack's laid-back approach to work holds him back. That all changes when a new cashier, named Amy (Jessica Simpson), transfers to their store. Zack is instantly smitten, but Amy prefers Vince. Zack determines that the only way to win her is to win his store's most coveted honor.

programme.title: Hearts in Colombo
programme.desc: When Rick surprises Shanaya by flying to Sri Lanka for Christmas, meeting her eccentric family leads to chaos, wild antics, and culture clash. Can their relationship survive the ultimate holiday test in this heartwarming Sri Lankan rom-com?

programme.title: You Hurt My Feelings
programme.desc: A novelist's (Julia Louis-Dreyfus) longstanding marriage is suddenly upended when she overhears her husband give his honest reaction to her latest book. A film about trust, lies, and the things we say to the people we love most.

programme.title: The Thing from Another World
programme.desc: When scientist Dr. Carrington (Robert Cornthwaite) reports a UFO near his North Pole research base, the Air Force sends in a team under Capt. Patrick Hendry (Kenneth Tobey) to investigate. What they find is a wrecked spaceship and a humanoid creature (James Arness) frozen in the ice. They bring their discovery back to the base, but Carrington and Hendry disagree over what to do with it. Meanwhile, the creature is accidentally thawed and begins wreaking havoc.

programme.title: Maximum Overdrive
programme.desc: After a comet causes a radiation storm on Earth, machines come to life and turn against their makers. Holed up in a North Carolina truck stop, a group of survivors must fend for themselves against a mass of homicidal trucks. A diner cook, Bill Robinson (Emilio Estevez), emerges as the unlikely leader of the pack, attempting to find an escape plan for himself and the survivors, who include his boss, Bubba Hendershot (Pat Hingle), and a newlywed couple.

programme.desc: When scientist Dr. Carrington (Robert Cornthwaite) reports a UFO near his North Pole research base, the Air Force sends in a team under Capt. Patrick Hendry (Kenneth Tobey) to investigate. What they find is a wrecked spaceship and a humanoid creature (James Arness) frozen in the ice. They bring their discovery back to the base, but Carrington and Hendry disagree over what to do with it. Meanwhile, the creature is accidentally thawed and begins wreaking havoc.

programme.title: Maximum Overdrive
programme.desc: After a comet causes a radiation storm on Earth, machines come to life and turn against their makers. Holed up in a North Carolina truck stop, a group of survivors must fend for themselves against a mass of homicidal trucks. A diner cook, Bill Robinson (Emilio Estevez), emerges as the unlikely leader of the pack, attempting to find an escape plan for himself and the survivors, who include his boss, Bubba Hendershot (Pat Hingle), and a newlywed couple.

programme.title: Great Tank Battles
programme.desc: The third episode opens with Rommel's second offensive in North Africa. programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall
programme.desc: For nearly five years, Hitler's Third Reich has dominated Europe. Germany braces for an Allied invasion, fortifying the Atlantic Wall with steel, concrete, and advanced weaponry. programme.desc: A journey into his world. The film explores the roots of Adolf Hitler and traces the story of his life from the town of his birth to his final days in a Berlin bunker.

programme.title: World of Warships Clash of Titans
programme.desc: World War II at sea was marked by the rise of submarines, leading to fierce battles above and below the waves. Crews faced overcrowding and claustrophobia in these confined spaces. This technological evolution paved the way for modern submarines. Developed by Germany, submarines became as crucial to naval warfare as strategic bombers were to the skies, with other countries soon following suit.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: Speeding behind German lines the men of Troop A, in their armored cars and half-tracks left destruction and fear in their wake. Surprising the German garrison at the town of Epernay, they established an outpost from which they could defend a counter-attack. Outnumbered and outgunned with thirteen rounds of ammunition left, these brave GI's held this vital town until re-enforcements could arrive.

programme.title: The Attackers
programme.desc: Amidst WWII's war-torn skies, Soviet Major Bestuzhev defends the airdrome. A bond forms with comrade Zhenya, but facing overwhelming odds, they must protect their homeland, confronting fears in a narrative of sacrifice, courage, and camaraderie. As the air raid sirens wail, they delve deeper into the turmoil of war, discovering the true essence of duty and the resilience of the human spirit.

programme.title: Modern Warfare: Russia In Afghanistan
programme.desc: In 1979, the Soviets had ill-suited uniforms and inferior fighting tactics, and found it impossible to defeat the popular Afghan guerrilla army. They had underestimated their enemy and lacked the forces to win.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: Shortly before the outbreak of the Second World War, the Polish and British have succeeded in de-coding the top secret German military codes known as 'Enigma.' This information, referred to as 'Ultra' by the Allies, becomes vital for the Allies' military situation in North Africa, the Soviet Union, and Northern France.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Landing Craft - Establishing Beachead. Silent film.

programme.title: The Dawns Here are Quiet (English Version)
programme.desc: It is late spring of 1942, and World War 2 is in full swing. A long way off from the front-line the Germans make an air landing operation in an attempt to get through to the Kirov railway and the White Sea - Baltic Sea Canal. The only obstacle in their way is an anti-aircraft artillery unit of corporal Vaskov and five young women in training.

programme.title: Vichy and the Nazis: A Deal with the Devil

programme.title: My Grandparents' War
programme.desc: Kristin Scott Thomas's grandfather William served as a Commanding officer in the Royal Navy throughout WW2. He survived some of the most devastating battles from Dunkirk to D-Day but never spoke about his experiences. For the first time, Kristin uncovers how he saved thousands at Dunkirk and endured the horrors of the Russian Artic convoys. Kristin's journey is packed with revelation and emotion.

programme.title: The Amazing World of War Machines
programme.desc: Another basic building block of civilization and warfare is the ship. From the Second Millennia BC, ships were used to transport troops to battle. The Egyptians and Syrians crossed the sea to do battle, and when they weren't fighting each other, they would use their vessels for trade, exploration and probably a little piracy! From the 7th and 6th centuries B.C, formal navies appeared.

programme.title: Nazi War Criminals
programme.desc: Nazi war criminals are put on trial for their war crimes committed during WWII. This program covers various events from the Lublin Massacre, German atrocities in concentration camps and many others

programme.title: My Grandparents' War
programme.desc: Carey Mulligan's grandfather Denzil Booth, travelled thousands of miles to fight the Japanese in the final months of the war. His university education meant Denzil was fast-tracked to be a junior officer in the Navy. He lost his closest friends on board the first ever ship to be attacked by a Japanese Kamikaze. Carey travels to Japan to understand the culture of the Kamikaze from the other side.

programme.title: Hitler's Last Secrets: Hitler and Wagner
programme.desc: From the moment in 1906 when he heard the first note of Lohengrin at Linz opera house until his death in the burning ruins of Berlin in 1945, Hitler was obsessed by the music and mythology of Richard Wagner. The latest research into the often overlooked relationship with musician August Kubizek, his only boyhood friend, has provided clues which have reveal the overwhelming importance of Wagner.

programme.title: WWII: Mysteries in the Archives 1938-1948
programme.desc: In April 1945, just weeks before the war's end, Allied troops advancing on the Western Front uncovered and liberated numerous POW, labor, and concentration camps.
